notes: Bell's Clarity elections.json lists the 2024 general (EID 122428) but not the 2026 primary or runoff. The county site www.bellcountytx.com has a robots.txt that disallows all agents except named search bots ('User-agent: * Disallow: /'), so the fetch module refuses it and the county's links to 2026 Clarity EIDs or posted reports could not be read; one web search found only the county Notices and Election Results Archive pages (same blocked host), no Clarity EID. Vote types read from cached detail.xml: the 8:36 PM update has early and absentee precinct numbers only; election-day precinct numbers first appear at 9:15 PM. Check 3 pending for 2026 primary and runoff (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: Only the 2024 general is determined (LIVE: election-day precinct numbers in six election-night Clarity updates), so by rule the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with confidence low.

2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122428 '2024 General Election' night versions with 64 precincts with votes: 8:36:42 PM CST (Early and Absentee only), then Election Day precinct sums 127744 (9:15:44 PM), 253757 (9:46:05 PM), 383100 (10:20:51 PM), 495195 (10:52:59 PM), 593784 (11:33:25 PM), 656353 (11/6/2024 12:35:15 AM CST), each in 64 precincts.

2026_primary.fact: Not listed on Bell's Clarity elections.json; county site blocked by robots.txt so no EID or county report could be read. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: Not listed on Bell's Clarity elections.json; county site blocked by robots.txt so no EID or county report could be read. Check 3 pending. Check after full harvest 2026-10-03 (check3-H2): the 7:51 PM CDT capture of Bell's elections page links 'Election Results' to Clarity EID 126390; its detail.xml (Region Bell, ElectionDate 5/26/2026) has election-night versions at 7:04, 8:53, 9:58 and 10:22 PM CDT, but every vote value, precinct and county alike, is 'protected' in every version through 6/2/2026, so no election-night evidence either way; stays UNDETERMINED.
